E14S.meaning: Cells sorted as ImageIT hypoxia-marker negative at harvest.

E15S.meaning: Cells sorted as ImageIT hypoxia-marker positive at harvest. Includes currently hypoxic and post-hypoxic (reverted) cells because marker positivity is not identical to ongoing transcriptional hypoxia.

implications: E14S vs E15S composition differences are partly by design (sort gate), not only different tissue faces.
GFP+/ImageIT+ does not equal persistent hypoxia: velocity resolves entering, persistent, exiting, and reverted states within the marked pool.
Reverted states in E15S are expected — cells that experienced hypoxia (marker+) but transcriptionally left the hypoxic program.
Entry≠exit asymmetry and front geometry are most biologically interpretable within E15S (hypoxia-marked) and as contrasts against E14S (unmarked).
note: Only ~12% of E15S (GFP+/ImageIT+) tumor dynamics cells are velocity-persistent; the rest of the marked pool is entering, exiting, transitional, or reverted.
